patch.summary: Move removed Stripe field reads to their documented new locations, replace payment_method_types: ['card'] with allowed_payment_method_types, and update the pinned Stripe API version.
warnings: Subscription periods are read through a generated helper: the old subscription-level field when present (old-version events), otherwise the period every item shares, otherwise the item the application already selects or the configured price policy. Webhook endpoints are not changed.

payment_method_types: ['card'] becomes allowed_payment_method_types: ['card'] under the owner-approved policy. In 2026-09-30.endive it filters the payment methods Stripe finds eligible instead of listing them, so keep cards enabled in the Stripe Dashboard or the payment method configuration this account uses.
The stripe package is not upgraded. TypeScript projects may need the stripe package version matching the new API version before they typecheck.
